name: ThemeHero
description: Responsive theme storytelling hero with a two-column desktop composition and full-bleed mobile artwork behind selectable copy and one primary CTA.

figma.notes: English Site Optimization 2026 Theme Hero. Desktop preserves the approved two-column composition; mobile adopts W Concept's full-bleed artwork with bottom-aligned copy and a contrast scrim.

image.description: Foreground campaign artwork with meaningful alt text and intrinsic dimensions.

backgroundImageSrc.description: Alternate decorative source for the blurred full-bleed atmosphere; defaults to image.src.

cta.description: Optional primary action rendered with the shared inverse Button.

focus.note: The composed Button supplies the token-backed inverse focus ring.

radius.note: The CTA consumes --radius-md from the Figma Full Inverse control.

typeHierarchy.note: The module uses a display heading, heading-xs supporting copy and body-xl CTA label.

accessibility.role: section with heading, descriptive copy, image and optional button
accessibility.ariaPattern: decorative atmosphere hidden from assistive technology; meaningful foreground image alt; native heading and button
accessibility.structure: The visible h2 introduces selectable supporting copy. The blurred duplicate is decorative; the foreground image is semantic.
accessibility.interaction: The optional CTA composes the shared Button and inherits its keyboard, disabled and focus behavior.
